meta.name: description
meta.content: The Basic is a petal in florr.io. As its name suggests, the Basic is the most simple petal in florr.io, with fairly standard stats and no special characteristics. The Basic is the first petal that the player obtains, and was also the first petal added to the game. The visual appearance of the...

meta.content: The Basic is a petal in florr.io. As its name suggests, the Basic is the most simple petal in florr.io, with fairly standard stats and no special characteristics. The Basic is the first petal that the player obtains, and was also the first petal added to the game. The visual appearance of the Basic can be described as a white circle with a light gray outline. The Basic is a very standard petal, with the relatively modest and balanced attributes of 10 Health and Damage at Common. The Basic...

meta.content: Inside Magic: The Gathering SDCC 2026 | Collector's Quest

Step inside the Hasbro booth at San Diego Comic-Con as we sit down with Mark Rosewater, Head Designer for Magic: The Gathering, to discuss the highly anticipated Marvel collaboration!
We get an inside look at the creative brainstorming process behind bringing Earth's Mightiest Heroes to the tabletop—including how a giant whiteboard helped shape the set, the inspiration behind an unexpected "deep cut" character choice, and how the design team created brand-new gameplay mechanics for iconic artifacts like Thor's hammer, Mjölnir. We also explore how famous comic book locations were selected for land cards before wrapping things up by opening a fresh booster pack right on the show floor to see what cards we pull!

The Basic is a petal in florr.io. As its name suggests, the Basic is the most simple petal in florr.io, with fairly standard stats and no special characteristics. The Basic is the first petal that the player obtains, and was also the first petal added to the game.
Contents
1 Appearance
2 Function
3 Obtainment
3.1 Flowers
3.2 Ghost
3.3 Rift
3.4 Purchasing
4 Strategies
5 Gallery
6 Trivia
Appearance[]
The visual appearance of the Basic can be described as a white circle with a light gray outline.
Function[]
The Basic is a very standard petal, with the relatively modest and balanced attributes of 10 Health and Damage at Common. The Basic does not have any special characteristics, and as such is considered the most fundamental petal in all of florr.io.
The Basic acts as a sort of "baseline" from which other petals are balanced from. As such, many other petals share certain characteristics with the Basic, such as the 2.5 second reloading time.

Obtainment[]
Five Common Basics are given to new Flowers and Guests upon account creation. These five Basics start equipped in the player's active loadout, except the fifth slot which is occupied by a Common Rose with the Basic in the secondary loadout.
The five starter Common Basics cannot be used for crafting into an Unusual Basic. Additionally, any additional Common Basics beyond the free ones given on account creation are Unobtainable.
The Basic also cannot be traded for a Coin or Absorbed at any rarity, being one of the few petals with this restriction.
Upon entering a Rift, players are also given this starter loadout: five Common Basics and a Common Rose.
A reward choice between a Super Basic and the Unique Champion's Crown is awarded to the winner of a Battle Royale (Rift) match.
The Unique Champion's Crown gives nearby flowers a temporary Super Basic.
Flowers[]
Flowers in Hel drop two Basics when defeated. One of the Basics goes directly to the inventory of the defeated flower, while the other Basic drops as item form for any player to pick up. This means that the defeated flower can obtain both of their death Basics if no other player had picked it up.
The rarity of the dropped Basic scales with the amount of Score the flower had before death, as shown in the below table.
The mathematical formula to calculate the score values for Basic thresholds is
n e x t R a r i t y = p r e v R a r i t y ⋅ 2.5
(
1 +
1
c r a f t C h a n c e
)
{\displaystyle nextRarity=prevRarity\cdot 2.5\left(1+{\frac {1}{craftChance}}\right)}
, with Common = 2.5.
Players with below 17 Score will not drop a Basic at all, because the Common Basic is Unobtainable.

Ghost[]
The Basic can drop from the Ghost:

Rift[]
The winner of a Battle Royale (Rift) instance has a Super Basic as one of their reward options for victory.
Purchasing[]
Unlike most other petals, the Basic cannot be purchased from the Shop.
Strategies[]
Although the Basic's description implies that it is "not too weak", the Basic happens to be one of the weakest petals in florr.io. The player is highly advised to replace their starting Common Basics with stronger Petals as soon as possible.
Regular players are recommended to travel to Ant Hell, and farm Soldier Ants for Glass.
Players in a Rift match are recommended to kill any nearby Bees to obtain Stinger. Players which spawn outside of Rift Garden are highly recommended to travel to Rift Garden at some point in the match to obtain Stinger.
The player is generally discouraged from using Basic as a damage petal, with the exception of Super Basics earned from a Rift victory.
Gallery[]

Trivia[]
Basic and Rose are the first petals a player obtains, because 5 Common Basics and 1 Common Rose are given to the player upon account creation.
The florr.io developer M28 used to award Ultra Basics for people who successfully reported bugs in the game's Discord server. Afterwards, M28 decided to reward Common Squares for bug reports instead.
To accommodate this change, every preexisting Ultra Basic was converted into a Common Square on the day this decision was made.
At the present day, no in-game rewards are awarded when reporting a bug.
The only other petals that had this conversion were Epic+ Peas which turned into Grapes of the same rarity to accommodate the petal lineage separation from normal Peas to poisonous Peas (Grapes).
Basic, Faster, Heavy and Light are petals named after adjectives, rather than substantives. They are the only petals to have that characteristic, and all four are from legacy florr.io.
In legacy florr, a similar set of petals have that naming style: Basic, Fast (renamed to Light), Faster, Heaviest (renamed to Heavy) and Heavy (removed).
It is theorized to be possible to drop Ultra and Super Basics from defeated flowers in Hel. However, no player has ever reached the immensely high score requirement.
The Unusual Basic is the only non-Common petal to be unable to be crafted from its previous rarity at all.
It used to be possible for players to craft Common Basic from Mythic Basics before the Talents (at the time called Skills) update. It had a 100% success rate at the time.
In legacy florr.io, a glitch called the "Special Basic Obtaining Glitch" used to exist (and still exists in static florr.io servers). It consisted of dying at a high level while not collecting any petals (or a maximum of 3), then respawning. The player would get the normal 5 Basics and an additional one for level 15, another one for level 30 and another one for level 45, if the player respawned at those levels or higher. Those glitched Basics also had a chance to be Unique Basics.
Mythic+ Basics formerly had an exclusive trait to themselves: they used to sparkle like legacy Unique Basic.
At an unknown time after the Super petal update, the sparkling on Mythic Basics was transferred to Super petals.
As of the present day, Super petals no longer have particles and instead those particles are present on Eternal petals.
Destroyed players in Hel drop two Basics: One is dropped as an item, but the other goes directly to the destroyed player's inventory.
The Damage of the Basic matches with the Body Damage stat of many different mobs. Some of these mobs are: Ants, Bush, Centipedes, Ladybugs, Leech, Rock (Mob), Shell (Mob), Sponge (Mob) and Termites.
On June 17th 2024, the developer sent players who were at the bottom right of Desert to Hel, and gave all of them 10 Super Basics each. This, however, wasn't saved onto their inventories.
Before August 27th, 2024, it was theorized that Basic could be dropped outside Hel. However, because PvP was exclusive to Hel (and formerly PvP) at the time, Basics were only seen dropping there. Ever since a player obtained Corruption, it was confirmed that Basics are tied to Hel regardless of PvP outside of other zones.
Basic, Chip, Coin, Corruption and Square are the only petals unable to appear in the Shop.
Basic is likely not obtainable from the Shop because it used to be exclusively obtainable from defeating other flowers.
Super Basics used to be considered one of the hardest Super petals to obtain. Now, new methods of obtaining the Basic such as the Ghost and the Rift have made the Basic significantly easier to obtain.
On March 30th 2025, M28 placed down 5 Super Basics as item drops and told players to find them in the Pyramid. One of the owners of these Super Basics is Hot_X_Donalds, confirming that M28 did not take away the Super Basics after the event ended.
M28 once said Basics will be used to craft the Soul Splitter. However, the Soul Splitter is still unreleased, and there is no information on whether this is actually true.
Basic is now the only petal in game that can be obtained from all the biomes (from ghosts in garden ocean and desert and players in hel)
On December 23rd 2025, the first Super Basic from a Rift Victory was obtained by Skware.
On May 5th 2026, an Eternal Basic was crafted by giorg1. It was also the first ever Eternal petal.
Expand
[V] • [E]
